Subject: Discovery recap + schedule technical deep dive and pilot slots

Hi Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Discovery highlights:
- Primary goal: reduce triage time in HealthMate’s clinical routing by surfacing likely-coding matches and suggested dispositions.
- Key constraint: 1) sub-100ms median latency for inference path that touches clinician UI, 2) no PHI persisted outside your VPC for pilot.
- Success metric (what you asked for): >20% reduction in time-to-first-triage for the pilot cohort and precision@10 >= 0.75 on coding suggestions.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Technical deep dive (45–60m): architecture, integration touchpoints, and latency profile. We’ll bring the runtime lead and a demo engineer.
2) Evaluation kickoff (30m): agree pilot scope, success criteria, prompt set, and rollout plan.
3) Share pilot prompt pack + success metrics spreadsheet ahead of the kickoff.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 13 — 10:00–11:00 AM PST (our preferred)
- Thu Dec 15 — 08:00–09:00 AM PST
- Fri Dec 16 — 01:00–02:00 PM PST

Can you confirm which of these works for your team? Also helpful to know who from HealthMate will join (engineer + PM recommended). I attached a quick draft MPA and the pilot success metrics workbook for your review.

Attachments: healthmate_mpa_draft.pdf (stub), pilot_success-metrics.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben and Marissa on the internal owners.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Security: we’ll need SOC 2 contact details and a short runbook on how Redwood handles cache/kv persistence during the pilot.
- Timezone: we operate in EST — the Dec 13 slot at 10:00 AM PST (1:00 PM EST) would work best for us. The Dec 15 morning slot would be tight because of team standups.

Option A: Tue Dec 13, 1:00 PM EST (10:00 AM PST) — preferred
Option B: Fri Dec 16, 4:00 PM EST (1:00 PM PST) — backup
